false_positive_windows_discrepancy_inves.mathematical_reconciliation: 74 (offline cached windows) - 1 (trailing silence window from positive file u_b6hqzcpu1z-handgun-sound-effect-432110) + 4 (net additional boundary windows created during continuous streaming hop framing across 81 files) = 77.

u_b6hqzcpu1z-handgun-sound-effect-432110.explanation: Gunshot recording with timestamp-aware trailing silence window (y=0). Included in features_test.npz, but excluded from background-only continuous evaluation.

meditation_hypnosis--110246.explanation: Continuous audio slicing produced 34 windows vs 33 offline windows due to audio end padding.

freesound_community-laser-compilation-05.explanation: Continuous audio slicing produced 11 windows vs 9 offline windows due to boundary framing.

policy_a_pure_background_only.description: Calculates false alert rate strictly on pure background audio recordings, completely excluding gunshot files.

policy_b_total_non_gunshot_exposure.description: Includes pure background audio plus verified non-gunshot pre-onset and trailing silence intervals from gunshot recordings.

formal_definitions.positive_window: A 0.96s audio window with >= 0.15s verified overlap with a physical gunshot event interval (ground truth label y=1).
formal_definitions.negative_window: A 0.96s audio window with <= 0.05s overlap with a gunshot event interval (ground truth label y=0), including all background audio and trailing silence.
formal_definitions.ambiguous_window: An audio window with 0.05s < overlap < 0.15s. Excluded from training to prevent label noise; evaluated conservatively as positive in evaluation.
formal_definitions.false_positive_window: A negative window (y=0) whose predicted continuous model score is >= operating threshold tau.
formal_definitions.predicted_alert_event: A temporal cluster of consecutive positive detection windows formed by the streaming hysteresis state machine (merge_detection_windows), characterized by onset, offset, and peak score.
formal_definitions.ground_truth_physical_gunshot_event: An experimentally verified physical firearm discharge defined in canonical_gunshot_events.csv by unique canonical_event_id, start time, and end time.
formal_definitions.duplicate_or_repeated_alert: An additional alert event triggered on the same physical recording that overlaps or falls within tolerance of an already-matched ground-truth event. Counted as a duplicate alert, not a false positive.
formal_definitions.recording_level_detection: A binary verdict indicating whether >= 1 alert event was triggered in a physical recording (detected vs rejected).
